retrievalProfile.description: A warm, monochromatic sepia-toned portrait featuring a subject with intricate braided hair and bold 90s-style typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast portrait of a woman with voluminous, high-piled braids, set against a solid ochre background. The entire image is unified by a warm, golden-brown color palette, emphasizing texture in the hair and metallic jewelry.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's face is the primary focal point, framed by the dark texture of the braids.
The warm ochre background provides a flat contrast to the detailed, shadowed textures of the subject.
Typography is positioned in the negative space to the left, balancing the off-center composition of the face.
The metallic sheen of the earrings echoes the highlights on the subject's skin and hair.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned slightly right of center, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the high-piled crown of braids.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes, upward to the hair height, then down to the jewelry and across to the left-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left side of the frame, used for typographic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Umber/Black (Hair shadows and facial contours)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between shadows and highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Enclosed within a pill-shaped or lozenge border
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' has a large, rounded bowl
The 'A' is wide with a low crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, structured display logo paired with a casual, organic script subtitle.
graphicDevices: Pill-shaped container for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, heavy weight of the display text.
Approximates the casual, handwritten feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a woman with very tall, thick braids in a sepia-toned monochromatic style against a flat ochre background. Focus on the texture of the hair and large metallic earrings.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, rounded uppercase title inside a pill-shaped border on the left side. Below it, add a small, white handwritten script subtitle that slightly overlaps the subject's hair.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm and monochromatic?
Does the hair have a distinct, heavy braided texture?
Is the main title enclosed in a rounded border?
Is the subject positioned off-center to allow for text on the left?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact earring design
Ensure the background is a solid color rather than a gradient
postGenerationChecks: Verify the rounded nature of the display font
Ensure the braids appear voluminous and textured
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the off-center subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast portrait + apply a warm sepia filter + add a rounded display logo in a pill-frame + use a script subtitle for secondary info.
